scoring_justification: Undoped gaps, bond angles, and formation energies are recomputed from raw artifacts; doped band gaps are scored only via trend audit because the paper gives no explicit absolute values for them. This uses T1 where possible and T3 where necessary.

items.dopant: string (one of: none, Pb-deficient, Sc, Y, La, Sb, Bi)

outputs.description: Scored summary of the paper’s headline quantities: energy and optical band gaps, Ti‑O‑Ti bond angle, and oxygen vacancy formation energy for all systems. The checker will recompute gaps from the supplied DOS and absorption CSVs, bond angles from the relaxed structures, and formation energies from the total energy data, then compare against hidden gold values with tolerances and verify monotonic trends.

output_contract.notes: The checker also reads the intermediate evidence files (dos_*.csv, absorption_*.csv, relaxed_structures.json, vacancy_total_energies.json, mu_O.json) that the agent must produce. These are not scored directly but are required for recomputation.

steps.description: Group IIIA energy band gaps satisfy Sc > Y > La (decreasing gap with increasing atomic number).
Group VB energy band gaps satisfy Sb > Bi.
Group IIIA bond angles satisfy La > Y > Sc.
Group IIIA optical band gaps satisfy Sc > Y > La.
Group VB optical band gaps satisfy Sb > Bi.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for energy band gap, optical band gap, bond angles, and formation energies from the paper’s text and Table I.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Fig.1, Fig.2, Fig.6, text (energy gap 1.75 eV, optical gap 3.74 eV), bond angles from text (Fig.6 description), formation energies from Table I.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the paper’s reported numeric values in the same units.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values published in the paper; they are the authoritative reference for this reproduction task.
